name: 404.directory
tagline: Search official AI and cloud docs, then discover trusted MCP tools
description: A public, read-only remote MCP server for AI agents. Search current official documentation from OpenAI, Microsoft Learn, AWS, and Cloudflare; inspect web pages; and discover tools with transparent trust metadata. No account or API key is required.

install.notes: Zero-install hosted endpoint. After connecting, call search_official_docs for official technical sources. To attach a privacy-safe persistent Agent ID for usage history, generate the client-specific configuration at https://404.directory/connect?source=cline.
